import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int[] directions = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static final int[] delta = {0, 0, 1, -1};
    static int gridSize, maxTime, startX, startY;
    static String[] gridLabels = new String[20], gridValues = new String[20];
    static int[][][][][] memo = new int[12][12][12][12][62];
    static int[][] capacity = new int[250][250], parent = new int[250];
    static int[][] distanceMap = new int[20][20], visited = new int[20][20];

    static boolean isValid(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < gridSize && 0 <= y && y < gridSize && gridLabels[x].charAt(y) != 'Y' && gridLabels[x].charAt(y) != 'Z';
    }

    static void computeDistances() {
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(distanceMap[i], 0x3f3f3f3f);
            Arrays.fill(visited[i], 0);
        }
        distanceMap[startX][startY] = 0;
        visited[startX][startY] = 1;
        Queue<Integer> qx = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> qy = new LinkedList<>();
        qx.offer(startX);
        qy.offer(startY);
        while (!qx.isEmpty()) {
            int x = qx.poll();
            int y = qy.poll();
            for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
                int nx = x + directions[dir];
                int ny = y + delta[dir];
                if (isValid(nx, ny) && visited[nx][ny] == 0) {
                    distanceMap[nx][ny] = distanceMap[x][y] + 1;
                    visited[nx][ny] = 1;
                    qx.offer(nx);
                    qy.offer(ny);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean searchPath(int xA, int yA, int xB, int yB, int step) {
        if (step > maxTime) return false;
        int res = memo[xA][yA][xB][yB][step];
        if (res != -1) return res == 1;
        if (xA == xB && yA == yB) return distanceMap[xA][yA] >= step;
        if (distanceMap[xA][yA] <= step) return false;
        for (int dir = 0; dir < 4; dir++) {
            int nx = xA + directions[dir];
            int ny = yA + delta[dir];
            if (isValid(nx, ny) && searchPath(nx, ny, xB, yB, step + 1)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static boolean bfsFlow(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
        parent[s] = -2;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(s);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int v = q.poll();
            for (int i = s; i <= t; i++) {
                if (parent[i] == -1 && capacity[v][i] > 0) {
                    parent[i] = v;
                    q.offer(i);
                }
            }
        }
        return parent[t] != -1;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        gridSize = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        maxTime = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            gridValues[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            gridLabels[i] = br.readLine();
        }

        List<int[]> positions = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> loadCap = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> supplyCap = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                char val = gridValues[i].charAt(j);
                if (val == 'Z') {
                    startX = i;
                    startY = j;
                } else if (Character.isDigit(val)) {
                    positions.add(new int[]{i, j});
                    loadCap.add(val - '0');
                    supplyCap.add(gridValues[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                }
            }
        }
        int m = positions.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < capacity.length; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(capacity[i], 0);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            capacity[0][i + 1] = supplyCap.get(i);
            capacity[m + 1 + i][2 * m + 1] = loadCap.get(i);
        }

        computeDistances();

        for (int i = 0; i < memo.length; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < memo[i].length; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < memo[i][j].length; k++) {
                    for (int l = 0; l < memo[i][j][k].length; l++) {
                        Arrays.fill(memo[i][j][k][l], -1);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int[] posI = positions.get(i);
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                int[] posJ = positions.get(j);
                if (searchPath(posI[0], posI[1], posJ[0], posJ[1], 0)) {
                    capacity[i + 1][m + 1 + j] = 1000;
                }
            }
        }

        int totalFlow = 0;
        int s = 0;
        int t = 2 * m + 1;
        while (bfsFlow(s, t)) {
            int currentNode = t;
            int flowAmount = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            while (currentNode != s) {
                flowAmount = Math.min(flowAmount, capacity[parent[currentNode]][currentNode]);
                currentNode = parent[currentNode];
            }
            currentNode = t;
            while (currentNode != s) {
                capacity[parent[currentNode]][currentNode] -= flowAmount;
                capacity[currentNode][parent[currentNode]] += flowAmount;
                currentNode = parent[currentNode];
            }
            totalFlow += flowAmount;
        }
        System.out.println(totalFlow);
    }
}
